goal: Agent text entries in the session transcript render as full multi-line text with original line breaks preserved and no truncation cap, wrapped to the widget width.

references: Spec FR-1: a multi-paragraph assistant text block renders with paragraphs intact; no ellipsis suffix on prose of any length
constraints: Only AGENT_TEXT prose drops the _short() flattening; other entry kinds keep their current collapsed bodies in this task

TranscriptEntry may grow a multi-line-capable body representation, but sequence/sub_index ordering and the control_command_id/control_command_error fields must keep their exact semantics so pending-command reconciliation keeps working
Redaction continues to run upstream in TranscriptTailer before classification; do not move or weaken it

Tests that pin the old single-line behavior must be updated in the same commit: packages/flywheel/tests/test_session.py::test_classify_assistant_text_block_renders_agent_entry and packages/flywheel/tests/test_session_screen.py::test_session_screen_renders_all_message_classes
Add test coverage for the FR-1 acceptance: multi-paragraph agent text renders with line breaks intact and without truncation
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: No markdown interpretation of agent text; render verbatim (LOOP_STATUS envelopes and markdown syntax appear as-is)
No changes to tool call/result, lifecycle, timestamp, or spacing rendering (later tasks in this phase)
Do not touch flywheel_core.audit CLI output
edge_cases: Empty agent text block: skip the entry or render header-only, never a stray blank block
Agent text containing carriage returns or trailing whitespace should not produce phantom blank lines
